en: A multi-view color postcard with a yellow-green border featuring four photographs of historic buildings and gardens in and around Dresden, Germany. The upper left circular image shows a manor house by a pond. The upper right rectangular image shows an ornate Baroque gallery along a water moat with a bridge in front. The lower left image shows a large palace with multiple domed towers behind trees and water. The lower right image shows a courtyard or garden with a fountain, flowerbeds, and people walking in front of a grand building. In the center, red German text reads "Dresden und Umgebung."
